question: abimelech-2 is recorded with more than one father: gideon, jerubbesheth.

actions.why: The Hebrew identifies Abimelech son of Jerubbesheth by his distinctive death from a woman's millstone at Thebez, identifying the same Abimelech recorded here. Jerubbesheth is another name for his father Gideon (Jerubbaal), whom JDG 9:1 names as his father.

note: The apparent second father results from separate records for the same man. Preserve the owner's relationship ruling in row 106757 when merging the records.
